description: This file implements the AVDTP (Audio/Video Distribution Transport Protocol) profile for Bluetooth, including client and server methods for discovering endpoints, getting capabilities, setting configurations, and managing endpoint states.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Implements the client-side methods for AVDTP, including discovery, configuration, and retrieval of capabilities.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Implements the server-side handlers for AVDTP, including endpoint discovery, capability management, configuration, and state transitions.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers available stream endpoints and reports them via callback.

methods.name: SetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a specific stream endpoint.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration of a specific stream endpoint.

methods.name: OnDiscover
methods.description: Handles the discovery of endpoints on the server side.

methods.name: OnGetCapabilities
methods.description: Handles retrieval of basic capabilities for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: OnSetConfiguration
methods.description: Handles setting configuration for an endpoint.

methods.name: DeserializeConfig
methods.description: Helper function to deserialize configuration payloads into endpoint objects.
